result.question: Qual a razão entre internações masculinas e femininas em UTI por ano, considerando apenas internações cirúrgicas (ESPEC = 1)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 1 THEN 1 END) AS homens_uti, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 3 THEN 1 END) AS mulheres_uti, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 3 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS razao_h_m_pct FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "ESPEC" = 1 AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: SELECT ano, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "SEXO" = 1) AS total_masculino, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "SEXO" = 3) AS total_feminino, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "SEXO" = 1) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "SEXO" = 3), 0) AS razao FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, i."SEXO" FROM internacoes i WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND i."ESPEC" = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
